Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ggsegverse (development version)

  • Initial development version.

  • library(ggsegverse) attaches the core packages (ggseg.formats, ggseg, ggseg3d, ggseg.meshes, ggplot2) and prints a startup banner. Set options(ggsegverse.quiet = TRUE) to suppress it.

  • Added ggseg_atlas_repos(), install_ggseg_atlas(), install_ggseg_atlas_all() and installed_ggseg_atlases() to discover and install atlas packages from the ggsegverse r-universe.

  • Added ggsegverse_packages(), ggsegverse_deps(), ggsegverse_sitrep() and ggsegverse_update() to report and refresh core package versions.

  • Added ggsegverse_conflicts() to report masking between core packages and other attached packages, ignoring re-exports of the identical object.

Developed by Athanasia Mo Mowinckel.
